relationships.subject: tDCS
relationships.evidence_quote: tDCS could significantly decrease the content of TNF-a in the cortex (F = 22.25, df = 2, 9, p < 0.001), thalamus (F = 20.66, df = 2, 9, p < 0.001), midbrain (F = 34.94, df = 2, 9, p = 0.017), and medulla (F = 35.10, df = 2, 9, p < 0.001)

relationships.subject: tDCS

relationships.subject: tDCS
relationships.object: neuropathic pain after spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: tDCS could significantly improve the thermal withdrawal threshold of SCI model rats when compared with the vehicle group.

key_findings: tDCS improved thermal withdrawal threshold and motor function in SCI rats.
tDCS shifted microglia from M1 to M2 in VPL, VTA and PAG and reduced pro-inflammatory cytokines in cortex, thalamus, midbrain and medulla.
